zh.title: 國際民航組織航空運輸會議通過部長宣言 聚焦航網與基礎建設
zh.summary: 與會國家同意推進航空運輸經濟改革，政策建議將提交 ICAO 理事會審議。
body: 國際民航組織（ICAO）11月20日宣佈，各國在蒙特婁舉行的第七屆世界航空運輸會議通過部長宣言，提出改善全球航網連結、促進民航基礎建設投資並提升監管效能等方向。
國際民航組織表示，會議有逾1,500名代表出席，涵蓋154個會員國以及觀察組織。與會代表也討論更新經濟與法律架構、投資專業人才，讓民航制度跟上技術變化。
會議提出的政策建議將送交國際民航組織理事會審議，再透過該組織的政策、標準及計畫推動。此次宣言先確立共同方向，後續仍有理事會審議程序。

en.title: ICAO air transport conference adopts ministerial declaration on connectivity and investment
en.summary: Governments agreed on economic reform priorities, with recommendations heading to the ICAO Council for review.
body: Governments adopted a ministerial declaration at ICAO’s Seventh Worldwide Air Transport Conference in Montreal on November 20. It sets priorities for air transport growth, improved connectivity, infrastructure investment and more effective regulation.

ICAO said more than 1,500 delegates attended, including representatives from 154 member states and observer organisations. Discussions also covered modernising economic and legal frameworks, investing in skilled workers and keeping aviation institutions abreast of technological change.
The conference recommendations will now go to the ICAO Council for review. ICAO said the proposed measures would be pursued through its global policies, standards and plans.

facts.claim: The Seventh Worldwide Air Transport Conference adopted a ministerial declaration on November 20.
More than 1,500 delegates attended, including representatives of 154 member states.
The conference recommendations will be submitted to the ICAO Council.
